blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison on Monday hit back at the prosecution panel for calling the defense “delatory” after her camp sought an hour-long break during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Nearly eight hours into the trial, defense lawyer Mark Vinluan asked for an hour to prepare his next set of questions for the cross-examination of Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura. Private prosecutor Mae Divinagracia criticized the request as “delatory.” Shortly after, Sison took the stand in defense of Vinluan. “When Atty.
